acceptedCitizen.method: Re-export of the original rigged citizen with three embedded 1024 PNG maps. Original triangles, UV connectivity, 22-bone rig and idle/walk/run clips preserved; 15 extra exported seam vertices.
acceptedCitizen.acceptance: Accepted after High 1080p comparisons under four lighting conditions and an 8-second movement comparison.
acceptedCitizen.benefit: 47.5% smaller GLB and 75% lower estimated RGBA8 texture allocation with full mip chains (64 to 16 MiB). No measured FPS improvement; one material draw and 37,799 triangles unchanged.
acceptedCitizen.handoffInventory: Original optimization handoff files remain unchanged; runtime-reference preserves the former production input outside that inventory.

limitations: RGBA8 texture allocation is an estimate, not measured VRAM
65m tree comparison not executed; conifer four-lighting matrix not executed
No mobile device or GPU timer benchmarks
Git push and Hosting results must be checked independently against delivered revision

productionUiSmoke.scope: Normal city loading, Walk/Gastown start, third person zoom, afternoon and fixed time. No performance benchmark.
